historical_references.reference: Divina was a celebrated courtesan of the Vijayanagara Empire in the 16th century. She was known for her exceptional beauty and intelligence, and was a favourite of the emperor. Her name means 'divine' in Sanskrit.

Divina was also the name of a 12th century Hindu goddess, who was the goddess of prosperity, abundance and power. She was worshipped in the regions of Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh, and her temples were known for their rich offerings and grandeur.
